metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace — skills, agents, and commands used across the Grizzly Endeavors project family.

plugins.name: grizzly-tools
plugins.description: General-purpose toolkit useful on any project: reasoning lenses, debugging discipline, code craftsmanship, planning/process, and review-ready writing — plus supporting agents and commands.

plugins.name: grizzly-misc
plugins.description: Hyper-specific skills bound to a particular tool, engine, project, or environment: Bevy UI, PinchTab browser automation, Jules delegation, Residuum brand, and homelab deploys. Install only where relevant.

plugins.name: grizzly-mail
plugins.description: Send and receive mail as claude@grizzly-endeavors.com via the self-hosted Stalwart server — an MCP server for end-to-end mail testing from Claude sessions. Requires the 1Password operator token on the machine.

plugins.name: grizzly-tasks
plugins.description: Manage tasks in the self-hosted Vikunja (todo.grizzly-endeavors.com) from the terminal with the vja CLI, including first-time setup on a new machine. Requires a Vikunja API token on the machine.

plugins.name: grizzly-llm-instructions
plugins.description: Write agent skills with the writing-skills skill and lint them with skill-lint (Vale rules and TypeSafe Jev judgments), as a CLI or pre-commit hook. Requires uv, Vale and a TYPESAFE_API_KEY.
